title: Factorbook: an updated catalog of transcription factor motifs and candidate regulatory motif sites.
authors: Pratt, Henry E; Andrews, Gregory R; Phalke, Nishigandha; Huey, Jack D; Purcaro, Michael J; van der Velde, Arjan; Moore, Jill E; Weng, Zhiping
one_liner_zh: 该文更新了TF motif数据库Factorbook，整合ChIP-seq和HT-SELEX数据注释候选TF结合位点，并提供机器学习工具，虽涉及TF-DNA结合位点预测但缺乏三维互作建模与动态机制研究，属于资源型工作，对本课题有数据和方法参考价值。
abstract: The human genome contains  approximately 2000 transcriptional regulatory proteins, including  approximately 1600 DNA-binding transcription factors (TFs) recognizing characteristic sequence motifs to exert regulatory effects on gene expression. The binding specificities of these factors have been profiled both in vitro, using techniques such as HT-SELEX, and in vivo, using techniques including ChIP-seq. We previously developed Factorbook, a TF-centric database of annotations, motifs, and integrative analyses based on ChIP-seq data from Phase II of the ENCODE Project. Here we present an update to Factorbook which significantly expands the breadth of cell type and TF coverage. The update includes an expanded motif catalog derived from thousands of ENCODE Phase II and III ChIP-seq experiments and HT-SELEX experiments; this motif catalog is integrated with the ENCODE registry of candidate cis-regulatory elements to annotate a comprehensive collection of genome-wide candidate TF binding sites. The database also offers novel tools for applying the motif models within machine learning frameworks and using these models for integrative analysis, including annotation of variants and disease and trait heritability. Factorbook is publicly available at www.factorbook.org; we will continue to expand the resource as ENCODE Phase IV data are released.
abstract_zh: 人类基因组包含约2000个转录调控蛋白，其中包括约1600个DNA结合转录因子（TFs），它们识别特征性序列基序以对基因表达发挥调控作用。这些因子的结合特异性已在体外通过HT-SELEX等技术，以及体内通过ChIP-seq等技术进行了分析。我们先前开发了Factorbook，这是一个基于ENCODE项目第二阶段ChIP-seq数据的以转录因子为中心的注释、基序和整合分析数据库。在此，我们介绍Factorbook的更新版本，该版本显著扩展了细胞类型和转录因子覆盖的广度。更新包括从数千个ENCODE第二和第三阶段ChIP-seq实验及HT-SELEX实验中衍生的扩展基序目录；该基序目录与ENCODE候选顺式调控元件注册表整合，以注释全面的全基因组候选转录因子结合位点集合。该数据库还提供了新颖工具，用于在机器学习框架中应用基序模型，并利用这些模型进行整合分析，包括变异注释以及疾病和性状遗传力分析。Factorbook可在www.factorbook.org公开访问；随着ENCODE第四阶段数据的发布，我们将继续扩展该资源。
